status: local draft only; not saved, scheduled or published on Substack
body:
A smooth first run can hide how much help the CSM gave.

Before handing a workflow over, watch one more real run. Can the customer do it with the access and help they'll have next week?

If one step still needs you, name that step and agree when you'll check again.

The one-page Second Run Check is here:
https://churnisdead.com/newsletter/second-run-test?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=notes&utm_campaign=second_run_test&utm_content=saturday_playbook
job: Help practitioners decide which part of one workflow the customer can take over; measure tracked transfer to the existing issue.
asset: No asset. Existing one-page worksheet is linked from the canonical issue.
approval_basis: Routine existing-plan preparation under Kuber’s 4 November delegation. Codex editorial decision; no claim that Kuber personally reviewed the text.

execution_gate: Read current Notes, saved drafts, scheduled queue and shared ledger; use an existing identical draft if present.
No missed Thursday/Monday backfill and no additional Note slot.
Complete any enforced exact-action approval requirement before scheduling once for21Nov20:30Sydney.
